column1: # Names for the arguments of the engine's Lua bindings, which no executable carries: each traced from what
# the binding's code does with the value, in the scripts' own Hungarian style. A number is `n`, or `i` where
# the scripts that pass it spell it so (iSticky, iFanfareType, iInlineIcon, iPlayerId); both are kept, as the
# the evidence fixes what the value is, `inferred` when it rests on a convention the evidence does not show;
# `status` is `proposed` until it is reviewed, then `accepted`. Positions and types come from
# binding_args.tsv (`exemap binding-args`); an argument with no row here keeps its type for a name.
# Graphics.Atmosphere was traced by hand (2026-11-06); every other binding that reads an argument was traced
# by one agent per namespace (at most 20 bindings each) and checked by a second that tried to refute each name
# from the cited code and call sites, keeping it, lowering it to `inferred`, or dropping it (2026-11-07). A
# row at a position binding_args.tsv does not list names a read it misses (its evidence says which). x360
# addresses are x360-retail, PC ones pc-v10.
